listing.name: Garou Labs: A Diable Submod
listing.summary: Hey folks. It's been a while since this got updated - several game versions and a change of hands for Diable itself- but now that <@312627217559715840> got to the rebalance and re-format to not use the original diableavionics prefix, it is finally ready to go. This also means there aren't patch notes, because it's been years.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a variety of weapons and ships, including a frigate with a weapon swapper, midline converts, and large meson family variants.

description: Adds a pile of weapons and ships. Includes a frigate with a weapon swapper, a set of midline converts like the Manta, and large versions of the meson family such as the Shahana strike beam and Thales defensive sweeper.
